tool_args.rationale: The pilot spans only H=0.16–0.48, whereas the target horizon is 21.1. The authorized mechanism guidance identifies a slow adaptation component, so a long-horizon discriminating measurement is needed before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon model using only the pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations do not identify the slow adaptation timescale or reliably constrain the forecast at H=21.1.
The slow-horizon probe directly tests the long-horizon reversal that remains ambiguous.
It does not resolve the identified temporal ambiguity.
